name: What is the step-by-step process for installing custom molding?

mainEntity.name: What is the step-by-step process for installing custom molding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom trim installation begins with room measurements and material selection, followed by acclimatizing wood moldings to your home's humidity. Next, old trim is removed, and existing drywall surfaces are inspected. The crew then precision-cuts, miters, or copes corner joints before fastening the trim into wall framing studs. Afterward, carpenters sink nail heads, apply wood filler, caulk along wall seams, and finish-paint. Because HH Remodeling manages both carpentry and interior painting, transitions between trim and drywall are completed by a single team without scheduling trade handoffs.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes measuring, prepping walls, precision-cutting and coping joints, securing trim to wall studs, and caulking, filling, and painting for a clean finish.
